sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with. Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal. Usually beats ultra-processed sweet snacks. That replacement value matters in real life.
